title: LibScript Base Component Variables
description: Core framework-wide configuration variables shared across all LibScript components.

LIBSCRIPT_HOME.description: Base installation prefix where LibScript installs isolated component versions.

LIBSCRIPT_DATA_DIR.description: Base data directory for runtime component state, databases, and service configurations.

LIBSCRIPT_CACHE_DIR.description: Directory where cached release metadata and build artifacts are stored.

LIBSCRIPT_BUILD_DIR.description: Scratch build directory used when compiling components from source.

LIBSCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_DIR.description: Staging directory where downloaded component archives and binaries are cached.

LIBSCRIPT_LOG_DIR.description: Base directory where component and lifecycle log files are written.

LIBSCRIPT_LOG_FILE.description: Explicit file path to append structured or text logs to in addition to standard output.

LIBSCRIPT_LOG_FORMAT.description: Output serialization format for lifecycle log messages (text or json).

LIBSCRIPT_OUTPUT_FORMAT.description: Shell or data output format emitted by env and status commands (sh, cmd, ps1, dotenv, json, text).

LIBSCRIPT_DEBUG.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling verbose debug and STACK recursion trace output across LibScript.

LIBSCRIPT_OFFLINE.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating offline execution mode using pre-hydrated local caches.

LIBSCRIPT_FORCE_OFFLINE.description: Strict air-gapped flag (0 or 1) that immediately aborts execution if any network call is attempted.

LIBSCRIPT_FORCE_FETCH.description: Flag (0 or 1) forcing remote artifact re-fetching even when present in the local download cache.

LIBSCRIPT_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) to simulate lifecycle and service operations without executing mutating commands.

LIBSCRIPT_AUTO_USE.description: Flag (0 or 1) automatically activating an installed component version in LIBSCRIPT_HOME/bin upon installation.

LIBSCRIPT_DRY_RUN_PKG_MGR.description: Flag (0 or 1) to simulate OS package manager invocations without mutating the host system.

LIBSCRIPT_DEFAULT_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Global override for how software should be installed ('libscript_native' prebuilt binary, 'from-source' compiled from source code, or 'system' via OS/selected package manager).

LIBSCRIPT_PKG_MGR.description: Explicit package manager override for 'system' or package-manager-driven installations (e.g., 'apt-get', 'apk', 'dnf', 'yum', 'zypper', 'pacman', 'brew', 'port', 'pkg', 'xbps', 'emerge', 'winget', 'choco', 'scoop', 'nix', 'guix', 'spack', 'vcpkg', 'conan').

LIBSCRIPT_WINDOWS_PKG_MGR.description: Global package manager override on Windows and MS-DOS hosts (libscript, winget, choco, scoop, vcpkg, rapps).

LIBSCRIPT_SKIP_SYSTEM_DEPS.description: Flag (0 or 1) to skip OS-level system dependency installation during component setup.

LIBSCRIPT_PROFILE.description: Active configuration profile identifier (e.g., dev, prod, minimal, hpc).

LIBSCRIPT_VERSION.description: Requested target package version override when not specified via <COMP>_VERSION.

LIBSCRIPT_SERVICE_NAME.description: Explicit service unit identifier overriding the default libscript_<component> service name.

LIBSCRIPT_SERVICE_RUN_AS_USER.description: System user account under which daemonized component services execute.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Global fallback bind address for network-listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_PORT.description: Global fallback TCP port for network-listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global fallback UNIX domain socket path for listening components.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_SYSROOT.description: Optional target root filesystem path when staging components into chroots or OS images.

LIBSCRIPT_ARIA2_EXPORT_FILE.description: File path to export aria2-compatible download manifests instead of downloading immediately.

FORCE_REINSTALL.description: Flag (0 or 1) forcing re-downloading and reinstalling a component even when already present.

FORCE_REBUILD.description: Flag (0 or 1) forcing recompilation or service unit regeneration from scratch.
